acceptance.criterion_verbatim: ZERO CROSS-GROUP SUMS EXPRESSIBLE -- demonstrate the primary-key discipline structurally, not by inspection.
acceptance.invocation: --guard mode, plus a column census of the emitted bridge
acceptance.output_evidence: HALF MET, and the halves are named. MET, the load-bearing half: the bridge carries NO money column -- verified, bridge money columns = []. Double-counting arises from spreading an additive quantity across memberships and the quantity is not on the membership grain, so the fan-out product CANNOT BE CONSTRUCTED -- structural, not a convention. The book figure exists only at GROUP grain in a column named book_mv_not_additive_across_groups with additive:false in the manifest. The --guard fires loud: naive SUM over dim rows $8,252,695,569.91 against a distinct-account universe of $1,550,733,057.94, a 5.32x phantom, and REFUSES. NOT MET: a TRUE PARTITION, each account in exactly one group, requires BD dim 436 which is absent from the feed. CONSEQUENCE, and it is the safe direction: absent the key these tables cannot produce an account-partitioned total AT ALL, correct or incorrect -- the failure mode is CANNOT-ANSWER, never ANSWERS-WRONGLY.
acceptance.denominator: bridge money columns 0 of 8; is_primary non-null 0 of 29,907; guard phantom 5.32x measured across 201 groups
acceptance.status_reason: The structural half is delivered and verified (no additive column on the membership grain; the guard fires). The PARTITION half is UNDELIVERABLE at this vintage: Primary Portfolio Group (BD dim 436) is not selected by persisted template 390224 -- measured 0 of 92 vendor columns match 'primary', positive control 'portfolio' = 8, and the pull sidecar's own level census reads Portfolio Group: 2. Fixable only vendor-side. The TO forbids deriving is_primary heuristically and I did not: an invented partition key would look populated and be unfalsifiable, which is worse than an absent one. Recorded FAIL rather than PASS-with-caveat because the criterion as written is not met.

mutant.description: The producer's book aggregation was mutated by REMOVING the supervision-sleeve term from its key -- reverting to (group, account) and keeping one row, which is the form both this producer and the T1 oracle originally shipped.
mutant.expected: If the sleeve term is load-bearing, group books must move, because an account split Supervised/Unsupervised would contribute only one of its two sleeves.
mutant.observed: FIRED. 12 of 201 group books change, total understatement $24,605,360.68 -- Austin Thompson, Lane Curry - Local Ops and Ted Grant each +$3,657,307.24; Collin Plotts +$3,159,412.24; Sydney Cobb, Patrick Mundlin and Campbell Huber each +$2,887,004.52; Hunter Lloyd and Sam Owens - Local Ops each +$497,895.00; 49F Schwab AUM, Christopher Spalthoff - Local Ops and Lane Curry each +$272,407.72. The correction is PROVEN, not assumed: for every sleeve, account_market_value / account_allocation == portfolio_group_market_value to the cent, i.e. both sleeves divide the SAME portfolio total, positive-controlled against an ordinary single-sleeve account; and the corrected key has constant market value on 29,926 of 29,926 keys, zero exceptions. The same mutant re-run against the T1 sibling moved 79 of 201 groups, |delta| $206,733,899.92.
